Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
How do you intend to oust? Bleeding
How do you intend to keep from being ousted? Ally blockers and rushers for key minions, not spending very much pool, continuous pool gain
What do you want your ready region to look like (ie, how many guys are you planning on getting out)? Shalmath, at least 2 allies, 1-2 other vamp by end game
What do you want your average turn to look like? My turn or another player's turn?  My turn, mostly untap with clothos and hunt, lots. Maybe a SH and a Sargon's action.
What's your metagame like? How do your opponents play? Mostly playing on JOL at the moment
What problems have you observed with the deck in play? Weenie swarm is the death of this, as well as a really strong !Ven grinder.

Unless this gets shut down pretty hard, early in the game, i tends to be able to build up and establish itself as a fairly good fortress style deck. Once the first oust occurs, you can usually take the table at that point.

Enkil cog is nice to have, madness network is awesome, but the deck can win without either
